records.title: Квалиа Мира и природа сознания
records.third_party_rights: Third-party materials retain their respective rights; see the source references and captions.
records.description: Прикладной учебник о квалиа, сознании, самосознании и рефлексии. Маршрут ведёт от описания собственного опыта к сравнению теорий, причинным проверкам и вычислительным моделям. records.third_party_rights: Third-party materials retain their respective rights; see the source references and captions.
records.description: An applied textbook on qualia, consciousness, self-awareness and reflection. It moves from describing experience to comparing theories, designing causal tests and building computational models. Designing a possible bearer of subjective experience is treated as a research question; successful program execution does not by itself establish experience.

records.third_party_rights: Third-party materials retain their respective rights; see the source references and captions.
records.description: A study of quantum approaches to consciousness and the authors' selective-interface hypothesis connecting organisms with more fundamental processes. Topics include decoherence, microtubules, nuclear spins, anesthesia and experiments that could distinguish explanations. Published observations are separated from models and thought experiments. Consciousness outside the body is not assumed to be an established fact; proposed mechanisms are discussed through testable consequences and possible negative results.

records.title: I Before Me
records.third_party_rights: Third-party materials retain their respective rights; see the source references and captions.
records.description: A research synthesis of published accounts of near-death experiences, pre-birth memories and encounters with the deceased. It distinguishes reported experience, recording history, independent corroboration and explanation, while examining time and personal continuity. Testimony records and calculation examples support source criticism and sequence checking. Narrative coherence is not treated as proof of life between lives, and the review does not claim exhaustive coverage.
